result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may assign to affiliates and M&A successors without consent; Licensor assignments require Licensee consent and cannot be made to a Licensee competitor; and Licensee change of control creates no termination right. However, it goes beyond what is needed by permitting partial assignments and deleting the original restrictions on sublicensing and transfers of license rights, potentially altering unrelated licensing protections. The added prohibitions on suspension, repricing, and modification are also broader than the stated playbook requirement. Drafting is generally professional but duplicative on change of control and awkwardly leaves a non-termination provision under an events-of-termination heading.
